episodes.task: Short grasp canary only; pick up the milk but do not transport it to the basket. Use the normal perception and grasp-candidate tools. Before contact, obtain a safe near-field wrist view and use fresh wrist evidence to refine or re-estimate the grasp; prefer the correction path supported by the evidence rather than blindly replaying the original contact anchor. Close the gripper, run a small safe lift/probe, and use fresh visual evidence plus assess_attachment_probe to decide whether attachment is proven by source vacancy and co-motion. Stop after one proven grasp, or after at most one failed close/lift attempt and one recovery attempt. Do not claim success from close acknowledgement or aperture alone. Official LIBERO placement reward is outside this grasp-only contract.
